name: Strong Drink
overview: Scripture presents strong drink as a substance that can bring both temporary joy and serious consequences. While Deuteronomy 14:26 acknowledges its use in celebration before the Lord, Proverbs warns that strong drink can be raging and deceptive, leading to sorrow, contention, and other woes (Proverbs 20:1; 23:29). Kings and princes are specifically cautioned against its use (Proverbs 31:4), highlighting the need for wisdom and self-control. At the same time, Isaiah 5:11 condemns those who pursue strong drink from morning till night, illustrating the danger of excessive indulgence.
